profile.headline: Sr. Software Developer at PNC Bank Corp.
profile.summary:
Analytical Information Technology professional with extensive expertise in systems analysis, project development, design, creating test plans, performance tuning and enhancing application systems

Early experience includes mainframe application development and credit & collection background in accordance with PUC regulations at Duquesne Light Company.

company.name: Sr. Software Developer at PNC Bank Corp.

positions.title: Software Developer IV
positions.description:
Team member of a Wire Transfer conversion and sunset projects between the Bank of New York and Mellon using Mellon’s home-grown Inquiry (CICS) teleprocessing monitor with an MQ Series interface, which updates VSAM files and a DB2 database.   Responsible for analyzing developing, testing, coordinating and implementing the conversion.
•	Helped to analyze, develop, test, coordinate and implement conversion turnovers.
•	Resolved Production/Test problems/abends.
•	Volunteered to run the daily Early Morning Wires Turnover.

company.name: BANK OF NEW YORK MELLON CORPORATION

positions.title: Software Engineer – Duquesne Light Project
positions.description:
Software Engineer – Duquesne Light Project
As a team member or independently responsible for the following:
•	Develop, maintain, enhance, implement and support for DISCuS and CACS customer service order and billing processes while a new Customer Care and Billing (CC&B) process is currently being developed.
•	Utilize COBOL/DB2 and COBOL/CICS for the following:  Customer Billing Projects, CACS and DISCuS.
•	All projects and enhancements were completed in a timely manner and had successful results.
•	Provided Test and Production Environment Support for these projects.

positions.title: Application Developer – PNC Financial Services Group Project
positions.description:
Team member of a conversion project between the PNC Financial Services Group and National City Bank N.A. using COBOL, CICS, DB2 and VSAM files.   Responsible for analyzing developing, testing, coordinating and implementing the conversion.
•	Helped to analyze, develop, test, coordinate, implement conversion turnovers and problem resolution.
•	Cost saving measure – Found obsolete GDGs and received permission to delete them.

positions.title: Senior Systems Analyst – Bank of New York Mellon Project
positions.description:
Team member of a Wire Transfer conversion project between the Bank of New York and Mellon using Mellon’s home-grown Inquiry (CICS) teleprocessing monitor with an MQ Series interface, which updates VSAM files and a DB2 database.   Responsible for analyzing developing, testing, coordinating and implementing the conversion.
•	Helped to analyze, develop, test, coordinate and implement conversion turnovers.
•	Resolved Production/Test problems/abends.
•	Volunteered to run the daily Early Morning Wires Turnover.

company.name: BANK OF NEW YORK MELLON CORPORATION

positions.title: Access/Risk Control Technician
positions.description:
Performed termination reconcilement across the following platforms:  Windows, ACF2 Mainframe, UNIX and SecurID.  Conducted daily research for excessive password changes and unsuccessful logins.   Processed monthly and annual UNIX and NT server reviews and certifications under the Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX).  Terminated or extended Offshore Development (India and local) personnel userids.
•	Uncovered a security gap where a terminated userid and password could be reinstated.
•	Provided accurate updates to the User Management Tool, which is the company’s system of record.
•	Provided accurate review and certification execution and verification for internal audit compliance.

positions.title: Application Developer IV
positions.description:
Team member of a six-year project with multiple increments for upgrading Mellon’s home-grown Inquiry (CICS) teleprocessing monitor, which updated VSAM files to a web-based / MQ Series interface with mainframe programs updating a DB2 database.  Responsible for analyzing, developing, testing, coordinating and implementing the following 16 Entitlement Services including Multibank, Wire Transfer, Account Reconcilement, Wholesale Lockbox, Check Image,  Ideal Forex,  and ACH Originations among others.  Provided on call 24-hour support.
•	Helped to analyze, develop, test, coordinate and implement DB2 database change turnovers.
•	Authored sections of instructional and structural program specifications for Offshore Development (India) personnel.
•	Resolved Production/Test problems/abends.
•	Volunteered for Early Morning Coverage Team and Emergency Floor Evacuation Team.
•	Provided stability for the Test and Production Environment

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst II
positions.description:
Recruited as a team member to analyze, develop, test, coordinate and implement the creation and maintenance of ORACLE PL/SQL packages for Health and Dental Carriers (Highmark Blue Cross Blue Shield, UPMC Healthcare HMO, Cigna Dental and Delta Dental).   Acted as a technical liaison between Thermo Fisher Scientific and Highmark Blue Cross Blue Shield, as well as the Cigna and Delta Dental companies.  Provided on call 24-hour support.
•	Integral team member responsible for the HR Payroll Upgrade and overall upgrade from Oracle Release 10.7 to ORACLE Release 11.0.3.
•	Resolved Production/Test problems/abends.
•	Health and dental services and ORACLE Release upgrades were completed in a timely manner and had successful results.
•	Provided Test and Production Environment Support for all health services.
•	Provided stability for the Test and Production Environments.
